*UnidosUS is a nonprofit, nonpartisan organization that serves as the nation’s largest Hispanic civil rights and advocacy organization. Since 1968, we* have built a stronger America by creating opportunities for Latinos and *breaking down barriers to expand economic and social progress for all. jobs.title: Billing & Account Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us:**



Cage \& Miles is one of the largest and fastest\-growing family law firms in Southern California. Our clients trust us to guide them through some of the most important moments of their lives, and we take that responsibility seriously. We are committed to delivering exceptional service through a team of talented professionals who lead with expertise, compassion, and integrity.



Our growth is fueled by a culture that values collaboration, continuous improvement, and investing in our people. We believe great teams don't happen by accident \- they are built through mentorship, professional development, clear expectations, and opportunities to grow.



As we continue to expand, we're looking for individuals who are motivated, client\-focused, and excited to help shape the future of our firm. If you're looking for a place where your contributions matter and your career can grow alongside the organization, we'd love to meet you.  

  

**Job Summary:**

The Billing \& Account Coordinator oversees a portfolio of client matters for assigned attorneys, ensuring accounts are managed with both urgency and care. This client\-facing role requires strong subject\-matter expertise in billing, collections, and account management. The ideal candidate is a polished, confident communicator who takes ownership of tasks from start to finish, works efficiently, and makes sound decisions. Strong problem\-solving skills and emotional intelligence are essential when addressing account issues and navigating difficult conversations with empathy, sound judgment, and respect. The right candidate is proactive and detail\-oriented, takes pride in maintaining accurate, audit\-ready work, and contributes to a supportive, collaborative team while delivering consistently positive client experience.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Manage a portfolio of client matters, ensuring accurate billing, collections, trust balances, and account activity while keeping accounts in good standing.
* Monitor accounts to identify outstanding balances, upcoming financial needs, and potential issues, using sound judgment to determine appropriate next steps.
* Partner closely with attorneys and paralegals to communicate account status, address retainer needs and resolve financial matters.
* Proactively communicate with clients by phone, email, and text regarding billing, outstanding balances, payments, and account concerns with professionalism and empathy.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks from start to finish, using sound judgment, problem\-solving skills, and firm systems to work efficiently and accurately.
* Maintain precise, audit\-ready documentation and contribute to a collaborative team environment while maintaining confidentiality and providing a consistently positive client experience.


**Qualifications:**


* Experience in customer service, account management, collections, billing, client relations, or a similar client\-facing role; prior law firm or professional services experience is a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with confidence and experience communicating by phone, email, and text.
* Strong emotional intelligence, interpersonal skills, and the ability to navigate sensitive or difficult conversations with professionalism, empathy, and sound judgment.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage a high volume of client matters, prioritize competing demands, and maintain accurate, audit\-ready records.
* Proactive and resourceful, with the ability to take initiative, make sound decisions, identify issues, and follow through without constant direction.
* Comfortability discussing financial matters, including billing, outstanding balances, payments, and retainers, while maintaining a professional and client\-focused approach.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; college education in business, accounting, finance, or a related field is preferred.

  


* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); experience with Clio, Super Set, or similar account management systems is a plus.

  


**Additional Information:**


* This position can be fully remote or hybrid, with the option to work out of any of our offices, Monday – Friday from 8:30 a.m. – 5:00 p.m

  


* The anticipated compensation for this role is $22 \- $26 per hour, but ultimately will depend on experience.

  


* Cage \& Miles has been named a Top Workplace by the San Diego Union \-Tribune, ranking \#2 among businesses with 50\-149 employees. This is a meaningful achievement driven by the voices of our employees and our shared commitment to excellence.

Working for Tower Cancer Research Foundation means being part of a mission\-driven organization where your work has a direct, meaningful impact. Every project supports groundbreaking cancer research and compassionate patient programs, allowing you to help advance better treatments while making a real difference in the lives of patients, families, and the local community—every single day.

**POSITION SCOPE:**

The Development and Events Coordinator provides administrative and strategic support to the foundation. This position involves event coordination support and execution, including donor management and support of the organization’s development team. It also provides administrative support for fundraising activities which may involve donor cultivation, gift acknowledgment, special events, donor solicitation, online (One Cause) and database (Raiser’s Edge) administration. · Ability to interface with donors, vendors, volunteers, and volunteer groups

· Additional duties as assigned

**PREREQUISITE KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND EDUCATION**

· Experience with Raiser’s Edge database management strongly preferred

· Strong organizational and communication skills, excellent attention to detail, and a solid work ethic

This is a full\-time hybrid in\-office role (WFH 2 days a week, in office 3 days a week). We are looking for someone interested in a long\-term career at RAGDOLL PR and who is interested in growing within the company.

This role is responsible for engaging with pertinent social media influencers, celebrities, celebrity stylists, stylists, etc. to ensure RAGDOLL PR brands are consistently being featured on influencers and on various celebrities and stylists. Part of the role requires an understanding of fashion, beauty, and lifestyle influencer/celebrity space to ensure we are aware of all of them. **About GRC Industrial**

GRC Industrial, LLC is an industrial electrical contractor serving manufacturing clients across California, Arizona, and Nevada. We deliver electrical construction, facility upgrade, and equipment installation projects for some of the most demanding industrial environments in the region — from process plants to high\-tech manufacturing facilities.

**Our Core Values**

At GRC Industrial, we believe great results come from great teams. We work hard, support each other, take pride in what we do, and want to build a company where people enjoy working together.

We value a team\-first mentality, open communication, collaboration, professionalism, accountability, and respect. We expect our leaders to take ownership, approach challenges constructively, work together toward solutions, value the expertise of both our office and field teams, and bring a positive attitude to work each day.

Success at GRC isn’t just about individual performance — it’s about delivering great results while helping the people around you succeed and building a company we’re all proud to be part of.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an Account Manager to grow and manage relationships with industrial manufacturing clients — specifically in the food \& beverage, automotive, and aerospace sectors. You’ll be the face of GRC Industrial to plant managers, facility engineers, project managers, and procurement teams, identifying electrical construction and maintenance opportunities and turning them into won work.

This is a hunter\-and\-farmer role: you’ll develop new accounts in our target verticals while deepening relationships with existing clients to capture repeat and negotiated work.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify, pursue, and win industrial electrical projects (installations, upgrades, expansions, equipment hookups, controls, and maintenance contracts) with food \& beverage, automotive, and aerospace manufacturers
* Build and maintain relationships with plant engineering, facilities, maintenance, and capital projects teams at target accounts
* Develop a territory plan and pipeline; track opportunities from lead through award
* Partner with our estimating team on scope reviews, walk\-downs, RFIs, and proposal strategy to ensure bids match what the client actually needs
* Attend pre\-bid meetings and site walks; gather field intelligence that sharpens our pricing and win rate
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and contract scope in coordination with leadership
* Stay in front of clients through the life of a project — handling change order conversations, resolving issues, and setting up the next opportunity
* Represent GRC Industrial at industry events, trade associations, and networking functions
* Maintain accurate CRM records, forecasts, and activity reporting

**What You Bring**

**Required:**

* 3\+ years of B2B sales or account management experience in electrical contracting, industrial construction, MEP services, or a closely related trade
* Working knowledge of industrial electrical systems and construction project delivery (bid/spec, design\-build, negotiated work)
* Proven track record of winning and growing accounts with industrial or manufacturing clients
* Ability to read plans and specs well enough to have credible technical conversations with facility engineers
* Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel regularly to customer sites for job walks and client meetings

**Preferred:**

* Existing relationships in food \& beverage, automotive, or aerospace manufacturing
* Field experience as an electrician, electrical PM, or estimator

**Why GRC Industrial**

* Established contractor with a strong reputation and repeat industrial client base

* Uncapped earning potential tied to the business you bring in

Yondr’s business segments span numerous industries, primarily across education and live events. Yondr supports schools through cell phone\-free programs. Yondr is seeking an Account Manager / Sales Lead to drive new business and manage key client relationships across the Shows vertical. Reporting to the Director of Music \& Events, this role sits at the intersection of artist relations and commercial execution — owning outreach and deal development with artist teams, agents, and promoters while ensuring seamless account management for confirmed tours and engagements. The ideal candidate is relationship\-driven, commercially sharp, and deeply fluent in the live entertainment ecosystem.

***Relationship Development***

jobs.title: HR Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position Summary


We're looking for an HR Operations Coordinator to handle the day\-to\-day processing of employee lifecycle transactions for Riser Fitness, including onboarding, employee changes, leave of absence administration, and offboarding. This is a hands\-on administrative role: you'll enter records, collect and verify paperwork, process changes in Rippling, triage the shared HR inbox, and keep employee files organized and accurate from a new hire's first day through their last. You'll take direction from the HR Operations Manager and work alongside Talent Acquisition and Payroll to keep every transaction moving on time.


Core Responsibilities


Onboarding

* Process new hire onboarding paperwork and system setup, from offer acceptance through Day 1
* Enter and update new hire records in Rippling, including personal information, compensation, and job details, as directed by the HR Operations Manager
* Collect and verify new hire documentation, including I\-9s, tax forms, and employment eligibility paperwork
* Send new hire paperwork and welcome communications, and follow up to make sure everything is completed on time
* Request system and platform access (Rippling, email, and studio\-level tools) and coordinate equipment issuance for new hires ahead of their start date


Employee Changes

* Process pay, title, position, and location changes in Rippling as directed by the HR Operations Manager
* Prepare and send change paperwork (offer letters, addendums, notices) and confirm employee acknowledgment
* Update personnel records to reflect approved changes and confirm accuracy against source approvals
* Route compensation or classification changes to Payroll and confirm they land in the correct pay cycle


Leave of Absence (LOA) Administration

* Process leave of absence requests and paperwork, including FMLA, state\-mandated leave, and personal/medical leave
* Track LOA dates, required certifications, and deadlines, and follow up with employees and managers on outstanding documentation
* Update Rippling records to reflect leave status, and route leave\-related pay and benefits changes to Payroll and Benefits
* Send leave\-related communications, including approval notices and return\-to\-work confirmations
* Maintain the LOA tracker and flag upcoming leave starts, returns, or expirations to the HR Operations Manager


Offboarding

* Process offboarding paperwork and checklist items for departing employees, including exit documentation
* Deactivate system and platform access and confirm return of company equipment on or before the last day
* Coordinate with Payroll to ensure final pay and benefits cessation details are handed off accurately
* Update personnel records to reflect termination details and rehire eligibility as directed


HR Inbox Triage

* Monitor the shared HR inbox and triage incoming requests, routing each to the correct owner (Payroll, Benefits, HR Operations Manager, or self)
* Respond directly to routine employee and manager questions on lifecycle, LOA, and general HR topics, escalating anything unclear
* Track inbox turnaround and flag aging or unresolved requests
* Keep saved replies and inbox documentation up to date so responses stay consistent and on time


Records \& Compliance

* Keep personnel files organized, complete, and audit\-ready across all lifecycle stages
* Track checklist completion for onboarding, changes, LOA, and offboarding, and flag outstanding items
* Assist with I\-9 re\-verification and other compliance paperwork as deadlines come up


General

* Answer routine employee and manager questions on lifecycle transaction status, escalating anything unclear to the HR Operations Manager
* Keep lifecycle trackers and shared documentation up to date
* Provide general administrative support to the HR Operations Manager as needed


Required Qualifications

* 2\+ years of experience in HR, HR administration, or a related field preferred
* Experience with Rippling or a comparable HRIS platform preferred
* Comfortable with data entry and processing multiple employee transactions at once without missing deadlines
* Clear written and verbal communication, especially with employees during onboarding, changes, LOA, and offboarding
* Ability to handle confidential employee information with discretion


Preferred Qualifications

* Familiarity with I\-9 and employment eligibility verification requirements
* Familiarity with leave of absence administration, including FMLA and state leave programs
* Experience supporting employee lifecycle transactions in a multi\-location or multi\-unit environment
* Comfortable following established checklists and processes in a fast\-paced environment

jobs.title: Client Success Manager
jobs.description:
At T\-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package \- this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth\-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year\-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!


\*\*\* This position may be located anywhere within the Mountain Time or Pacific Time Zones.
  

  

The Client Success Manager at T\-Mobile is a pivotal role focused on enhancing customer relationships and retention within the Government, Strategic, and Enterprise business segments. This position is responsible for managing the entire customer lifecycle, ensuring successful onboarding, product adoption, and continuous value realization. By identifying upsell and cross\-sell opportunities, the Client Success Manager works closely with sales teams to develop strategies that increase account value. Acting as a customer advocate, this role coordinates with multiple departments including sales, engineering, support, and operations to meet contract commitments and resolve issues. Through strategic business reviews and building trusted executive relationships, the Client Success Manager fosters long\-term partnerships and enhances client loyalty.
  

  

This role will support clients that reside on the West Coast of the United States other locations will be considered if they reside in this part of the country.**Job Responsibilities**:

* Customer Relationship Advocacy – Serve as the primary post\-sales point of contact for assigned government and enterprise accounts, advocating for customer needs across internal teams and ensuring a positive end\-to\-end experience. Build and maintain executive\-level relationships with client stakeholders to foster trust, understand business goals, and drive customer satisfaction and loyalty.
* Onboarding Product Adoption – Oversee new customer onboarding and training to guarantee a smooth implementation from Day 0 onward. Educate customers on T\-Mobile for Business products, services, and self\-service tools (e.g. Account Hub) to accelerate product and solution adoption, ensuring clients realize full value from their investments. Develop customer success plans and conduct regular health checks.
* Account Health Monitoring Reviews – Proactively monitor account performance and health indicators (usage trends, service quality, billing, NPS, etc.) to identify signs of risk or opportunity. Lead regular success reviews and QBRs, presenting key performance metrics and insights to client executives. Recommend action plans to address service gaps or evolving needs.
* Issue Resolution Cross\-Functional Coordination – Take ownership of customer issues and coordinate cross\-functional resolution, engaging internal experts to troubleshoot and swiftly resolve problems. Act as the customer champion in internal discussions, documenting interactions and ensuring service levels are met. Drive timely resolutions to maintain operational continuity.
* Retention Renewal Management – Develop and execute strategies to retain customers and secure renewals, mitigating churn. Analyze account health data to identify at\-risk accounts or partial disconnect requests and address root causes proactively. Lead contract renewal processes, negotiate terms, and finalize agreements that maintain or grow revenue.
* Account Growth Upsell – Drive account expansion by identifying and executing cross\-sell and upsell opportunities based on customer needs and usage data. Prepare and present proposals for new solutions, partnering with Sales and Solutions Engineering on complex opportunities that align with customer goals.

 **Education and Work Experience**:

* Bachelor's Degree Business Administration, Management, or related field (Preferred)
* Master's/Advanced Degree Business Administration, Management, or related field (Preferred)
* 4\-7 years Managing customer relationships and account management in business segments such as Government, Strategic, or Enterprise (Required)
* 2\-4 years Coordinating with multiple departments such as sales, engineering, support, and operations to meet contract commitments and resolve issues (Required)
* 2\-4 years Collaborating with sales teams to identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and develop strategies to increase account value (Preferred)

 **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**:

* Client Relationship Management Strong skills in managing client relationships at an executive level, ensuring customer satisfaction and loyalty. (Required)
* Cross Functional Relationships Ability to coordinate with multiple departments such as sales, engineering, support, and operations to meet customer needs and resolve issues. (Required)
* Strategic Thinking Capability to develop strategic plans for customer account growth through upselling and cross\-selling. (Required)
* Problem Solving Proficient in identifying problems and coordinating resources to provide effective solutions. (Required)
* Leadership Experience in leading teams and managing a distributed workforce to achieve business goals. (Required)
* Analytics Ability to analyze customer data to identify trends and opportunities for business improvement. (Required)
* Business Acumen Strong understanding of business operations and the impact of customer success on overall business performance. (Required)
* Telecommunications Knowledge of telecommunications industry, particularly in wireless technologies, to better understand and serve client needs. (Required)

 **Licenses and Certifications**:

* Certified Customer Experience Professional (CCXP): Certification that validates expertise in customer experience management, enhancing skills in customer journey mapping, and strategic alignment to business goals. (Preferred)
* Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification b

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, San Francisco
jobs.description:
**Program Coordinator, San Francisco** 

**Organization:** The Thriving Initiative **Location:** Hybrid (Approximately 75% remote, 25% in\-person)\| San Francisco, CA

**Employment Type:** Part\-Time **Hours:** 10\-15 hours per week **Compensation:** $20–$22 per hour

**Who We Are**

The Thriving Initiative is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit serving survivors on college campuses including San Francisco State University, San Diego State University, and UC Santa Barbara. Our programs are survivor\-centered, trauma\-informed, and grounded in deep respect for community healing.

We are a small but highly committed team. Every staff member is here because they believe in this work. We value innovation, empathy, community, and respect.

**Position Overview**

The Program Coordinator plays a vital role in the day\-to\-day program operations and community\-facing presence of The Thriving Initiative at San Francisco State University (SFSU) and in the broader San Francisco community. This role will support the planning and execution of events and workshops, build and nurture campus and community partnerships, and serve as an accessible point of contact for students seeking resources and connection. The ideal candidate is organized, empathetic, and passionate about improving the lives of survivors. This role reports to the Program Operations Manager.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program \& Event Support**

* Oversee and implement weekly in\-person healing and recovery workshops utilizing diverse alternative forms of healing
* Oversee logistics for events and workshops, including ordering and bringing physical workshop materials, setting up venues, and coordinating with service providers before, during, and after each event.
* Attend weekly staff meetings and a weekly one\-on\-one meeting with the Program Manager
* Works collaboratively with program team to ensure smooth program operations
* Attend and support both on\-campus and off\-campus planned events
* Assist with financial management related to events and workshops, including tracking expenditures and processing orders
* Oversee participant intake and attendance rosters for all sessions
* Assist with additional projects that are assigned

**Student Engagement**

* Directly coordinate all SFSU volunteer engagement activities and oversight.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator 2
jobs.description:
Stanford University's Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Spine Division is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Clinical Research Coordinator 2 (CRC2\) to support the research program. This position plays a central and independent role in managing all aspects of PI’s research portfolio, including industry\-funded clinical trials, multi\-site collaborations, registry studies, and grant\-funded projects including PI\-Initiated projects. The CRC2 serves as the primary research contact for sponsors, collaborators, IRBs, and internal stakeholders, and will work closely with surgical faculty, residents, fellows, and students.


This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced research professional seeking meaningful responsibility in a dynamic academic medical center environment.


Must possess and maintain a valid California non\-commercial Class C Driver’s License.


**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS\*:**

* Ability to drive day or night.
* Frequently stand, walk, twist, bend, stoop, squat and use fine light/fine grasping.
* Occasionally sit, reach above shoulders, perform desk based computer tasks, use a telephone and write by hand, lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh up to 40 pounds.
* Rarely kneel, crawl, climb ladders, grasp forcefully, sort and file paperwork or parts, rarely lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh 40 pounds or more.

*\* \- Consistent with its obligations under the law, the University will provide reasonable accommodation to any employee with a disability who requires accommodation to perform the essential functions of his or her job.*

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

* Position may at times require the employee to work with or be in areas where hazardous materials and/or exposure to chemicals, blood, body fluid or tissues and risk of exposure to contagious diseases and infections.
May require extended or unusual work hours based on research requirements and business needs  
* 

**WORK STANDARDS:**

* When conducting university business, must comply with California Vehicle Code and Stanford University driving requirements.
* Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrates the ability to work well with Stanford colleagues and clients and with external organizations.
* Promote Culture of Safety: Demonstrates commitment to personal responsibility and value for safety; communicates safety concerns; uses and promotes safe behaviors based on training and lessons learned.
* Subject to and expected to comply with all applicable University policies and procedures, including but not limited to the personnel policies and other policies found in the University's Administrative Guide, http://adminguide.stanford.edu .

  
**Core Duties** :


* Oversee subject recruitment and study enrollment goals. Determine effective strategies for promoting/recruiting research participants and retaining participants in long\-term clinical trials.
* Oversee data management for research projects. Develop and manage systems to organize, collect, report, and monitor data collection. Extract, analyze, and interpret data.
* Develop project schedules, targets, measurements, and accountabilities, as assigned. Lead team meetings and prepare/approve minutes.
* Formally supervise, train, and/or mentor new staff or students, as assigned, potentially including hiring, preparing or assisting with the preparation of performance evaluations, and performing related duties, in addition to instruction on project work.
* Audit operations, including laboratory procedures, to ensure compliance with applicable regulations; provide leadership in identifying and implementing corrective actions/processes. Monitor Institutional Review Board submissions and respond to requests and questions.
* Collaborate with principal investigators and study sponsors, monitor and report serious adverse events, and resolve study queries.
* Provide leadership in determining, recommending, and implementing improvements to policies/processes; define best practices.
* Develop study budget with staff and principal investigator, identifying standard of care versus study procedures. Track patient and study specific milestones, and invoice sponsors according to study contract.
* Ensure regulatory compliance. Regularly inspect study documents to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance.
Work with principal investigator to ensure Investigational New Drug applications are submitted to the FDA when applicable. Ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed.  
* 

**Minimum Education** **and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in a related field and two years of experience in clinical research, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :


* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and database applications.
* Experience with research protocols and regulatory or governing bodies, which include HIPAA and FDA regulations, Institutional Review Board requirements, and Good Clinical Practices.
Knowledge of medical terminology.  
* 

**Certificates and Licenses Required**

Society of Clinical Research Associates or Association of Clinical Research Professionals certification is preferred.

	+ Track and trace shipments daily

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Account Manager**
Sales Department*Job Description* **Position Summary:** Mirapath is looking for a goal\-oriented Territory Account Manager to cultivate and expand our footprint in the South Central territory. This role focuses on acquiring new business logos, generating a robust sales pipeline, fostering connections with potential clients, and growing strategic current accounts.
The ideal candidate will have existing industry ties in AI infrastructure, data centers, enterprise IT, colocation, or critical facilities, along with a history of sourcing and securing new ventures independently. This is a field\-based remote role. **Work Arrangement**: On\-site, Hybrid \& Remote

**Multiple Locations**: CA, MN, TX, VA

**Compensation**: Competitive Base Salary \+ Uncapped Commission (60/40 OTE Split \+ Performance Accelerators)**Position Responsibilities**
=============================

**Sales \& Revenue Growth**
===========================

* **Own new\-logo acquisition and revenue growth across the assigned territory.**
* Develop and execute a territory plan that identifies priority markets, target accounts, key stakeholders, partner relationships, and near\-term opportunities.
* Build and maintain a self\-generated pipeline through existing relationships, direct prospecting, referrals, industry associations, manufacturer and partner networks, events, phone, email, LinkedIn, and coordinated marketing activities.
* Drive sales for assigned accounts by building rapport, understanding account requirements, explaining product/service capabilities, negotiating contract terms, and finalizing contracts
* Expand sales (upsell) in assigned accounts by introducing new products and services
* Initiate sales process by scheduling appointments, making initial presentations, and understanding account requirements
* Recommend new products and services by evaluating current product results and identifying needs to be filled
* Monitor competition by gathering current marketplace information on pricing, products, new products, delivery schedules, and merchandising techniques
* Participate in team meetings and take responsibility for sales improvement initiatives

**Client Relationship Management**
----------------------------------

* **Build and maintain strong client relationships**
* Manage and resolve client concerns/issues during the entire sales cycle
* Provide product and pricing information by clarifying customer requests, selecting appropriate information, and answering questions
* Develop multithreaded relationships with data center, IT, network, facilities, engineering, procurement, operations, and executive stakeholders.
* Provide quality customer service in assisting customers on questions and/or requests
* Represent Mirapath at customer meetings, industry events, partner engagements, and regional networking opportunities.
* Explain the scope of all solutions and position them in relation to an organization's requirements

**Cross\-Functional and Internal Collaboration**
------------------------------------------------

* **Communicate, liaise, and negotiate internally and externally to facilitate the development of profitable business and sustainable relationships**
* Lead the complete sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through solution development, proposal, negotiation, closing, and post\-sale account expansion.
* Keep management informed by submitting activity and results reports
* Develop and tailor materials to assist the sales team in explaining key features \& benefits
* Work collaboratively and productively with other departments to meet customer needs
* Create processes that improve efficiencies and gather consensus and buy\-in from those involved

**Additional Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

* **Maintain all aspects of client records, including meeting notes and activities, in CRM database**
* Provide regular territory forecasts, pipeline updates, competitive intelligence, and account\-development plans to sales leadership.
* Develop and maintain knowledge of Mirapath's product set; participate in educational opportunities
* Attend internal meetings, exhibitions, and events as required
* Contribute to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed

 **Position Requirements*** BA/BS in a business or technical related field or equivalent combination of education and experience required. MBA a plus.
* 5\+ years of experience selling relevant and related products; experience with data center/IT infrastructure products a plus.
* Proficient computer, software, and data analysis skills (Salesforce.com/CRM, Excel, Outlook, Word, Power Point)
* Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
* Demonstrate strong initiative, resiliency, organizational and time management skills
* Exceptional interpersonal and leadership skills.
* Excellent problem solver with strong negotiation and presentation skills
* Proven record in business development and account planning/management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Resourceful and ability to adapt quickly to changing environment
* Ability to effectively prioritize tasks and manage time within a fast\-paced environment
* Travel up to 25% of the time

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------


Credit Genie is a mobile\-first financial wellness platform designed to help individuals take control of their financial future. We leverage artificial intelligence to provide personalized insights and are building a financial ecosystem by offering tools and services that provide instant access to cash, and building credit. Our goal is to empower every customer to achieve long\-term financial stability.

  

Founded in 2019 by Ed Harycki, former Swift Capital Founder (acquired by PayPal in 2017\). Backed by Khosla Ventures and led by industry pioneers from companies such as; PayPal, Square, and Cash App, we are well positioned to build the future of inclusive finance through cutting\-edge technology and customer\-centric solutions.

**Overview:**

As an Integrated Marketing Lead at Credit Genie, you will be responsible for owning how our brand shows up across every channel our audience touches. This is a broad, senior individual\-contributor role that brings brand marketing, social media, and influencer marketing under one roof, with the ownership to set strategy and execute it.


You will be the connective tissue across marketing: shaping our brand narrative, running an always\-on and campaign driven social presence, owning our influencer and creator program end to end, leading PR and communications, and orchestrating integrated campaigns that move people from awareness to consideration to adoption. You will partner closely with growth, design, product, customer service, and the people team to translate Credit Genie's mission into work that builds awareness, drives consideration, and earns lasting loyalty.

**What You'll Do:**


You will be the connective tissue across marketing: shaping our brand narrative, running an always\-on and campaign driven social presence, owning our influencer and creator program end to end, leading PR and communications, and orchestrating integrated campaigns that move people from awareness to consideration to adoption. You will partner closely with growth, design, product, customer service, and the people team to translate Credit Genie's mission into work that builds awareness, drives consideration, and earns lasting loyalty.

* **Be a brand ambassador.** Act as a champion and guardian of the Credit Genie brand executing our positioning, voice, and visual identity consistently across every touchpoint, and building brand awareness and consideration through on\-brand creative and brand\-building programs, including brand campaigns across channels such as OOH, video, and digital.
* **Build and own social strategy.** Establish Credit Genie's social media strategy from the ground up and own it end to end across all major platforms. Partner with the design team to develop campaigns, manage the content pipeline and editorial calendar, maintain a consistent brand presence, and tailor content to the strengths and audience of each platform.
* **Own influencer and creator marketing end to end.** Own the strategy and execute the full program: sourcing, vetting, briefing, contracting, content review, and reporting. Turning partnerships into organic growth in following and recognition.
* **Build the employer brand.** Partner with the people team to tell Credit Genie's story as a place to work. Culture and employee content that attracts talent and a strong presence on platforms like LinkedIn and Glassdoor.
* **Own integrated go\-to\-market.** Translate business goals into integrated campaigns that span brand, social, influencer, PR, OOH, and lifecycle channels — owning them from concept through launch and optimization as one coherent story.
* **Be the voice of our community.** Engage customers across social networks, nurture our communities, and protect brand sentiment.
* **Drive PR and communications.** Lead media relations, press materials, and announcement plans; secure earned coverage; and support launches, milestones, and issues and reputation management with leadership and legal.
* **Lead across the company.** Align partners across growth, design, product, customer service, and people, influencing cross\-functional teams without direct authority to deliver business outcomes and keep the brand consistent everywhere.
* **Measure, experiment, and optimize.** Define KPIs, run tests, and turn results and consumer insight into recommendations that shape strategy and investment — using web and social analytics tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Google Analytics, Sigma).

 **Requirements:**

* 7\+ years of experience leading all aspects of social strategy across major platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, and YouTube.
* Proven track record of building awareness and consideration
* Hands\-on experience owning influencer and creator marketing end to end: sourcing, briefing, contracting, managing partnerships, and measuring ROI.
* Proven track record of growing and managing social communities — day\-to\-day operations, growth, engagement campaigns, content strategy, and measurement.
* Successful experience partnering on employer branding initiatives and supporting the development of a strong internal and external brand narrative.
* Experience leading PR and communications \- pitching media, drafting press materials, securing earned coverage, and supporting issues and reputation management.
* Experience managing and measuring both ongoing and campaign\-specific social programs.
* Excellent creative judgment paired with a data\-driven mindset, with sharp attention to detail and strong organization.
* Strong analytical skills and experience with web and social media analytics tools and reporting (e.g., Hootsuite, Google Analytics, Sprout Social, Tableau).
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and building new programs from the ground up, with a collaborative style that influences cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Experience with consumer fintech or related industries is a plus.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the transactional database market. The PlanetScale platform offers both Postgres and Vitess clusters. Vitess, an open\-source database clustering system for horizontal scaling of MySQL, enables businesses to efficiently handle large\-scale data workloads — without sacrificing developer experience.  

  

PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top\-tier VCs including a16z, Kleiner Perkins, SignalFire, and Insight Venture Partners. And we serve some of the most innovative companies in the world such as Block, Anysphere (Cursor), MyFitnessPal, Etsy, Kick, and thousands more. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for early members of our Sales team that can form deep partnerships with our prospects and customers to help them adopt and succeed on the next generation of database infrastructure.



We host the databases behind companies like Cash App, Intercom, and Cursor. In other words: important databases.



We’re hiring a dedicated outbound SDR. You won’t inherit a dusty playbook assembled in 2017 and be told to “just add personalization.” You’ll help us build an AI\-native outbound motion from the ground up. You’ll work with modern tools, help create the playbook, and have input into how we build outbound from here. This role is for someone who wants to sell, experiment, automate repetitive work, and learn how great infrastructure companies go to market.



If that sounds exciting, and slightly intimidating, that’s probably a good sign!


**What ‘s the job to be done?**
-------------------------------


* Find promising companies that should be using PlanetScale, but aren’t yet.
* Research their architecture, growth, and likely infrastructure problems.
* Build creative outbound campaigns using tools like Claude and Clay.
* Talk to engineers and technical leaders without immediately saying, “Let me bring in someone technical.”
* Turn interest into real pipeline: a mapped buyer, an actual problem, and a reason to solve it now.
* Help determine what works, what doesn’t, and what we should scale.

**These attributes describe you.**
----------------------------------


* You have 1\+ year of quota\-carrying SDR or BDR experience.
* You’ve consistently hit your number.
* You’re early in your career, ambitious, and learning quickly.
* You already use AI to improve how you work—not just to rewrite emails with the word “delve.”
* You can show us something you built with Claude, Clay, or another AI tool and explain how it made you better or faster.
* When you encounter repetitive work, your first thought is, “Could a robot do this?”
* You’re curious about databases, infrastructure, and how modern AI companies are built.
* You actively seek feedback rather than treating it as a personal attack.

**What you will need.**
-----------------------



Not literal points. We do not have a leaderboard. But these will help:


* You’ve sold to engineers, platform teams, or infrastructure buyers.
* You’ve worked in developer tools, infrastructure, or open source.
* You’ve used Clay, Unify, Outreach, Salesloft, Gong, or Salesforce.
* You’ve worked somewhere with a real outbound playbook and know which parts are worth keeping.
* You can explain what a database does without checking Wikipedia first.

**Why PlanetScale**
-------------------



We're redefining how high\-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS.



PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.



At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.



If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!


**Location**
------------



This role is based in San Francisco. You'll need to already live here


**Total Compensation and Pay Transparency**
-------------------------------------------



An employee's total compensation consists of base salary \+ variable comp where appropriate \+ benefits \+ equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.



OTE: $100,000 USD

jobs.description:
Job Title: Store Program Associate


Reporting To: Store Program Manager


FLSA Status: Non\-Exempt, Part\-Time Hourly


Union Status: This is a Union position


Job Location: Berkeley, CA ( Onsite Role)

**Summary**


The Store Program Associate is responsible for providing support for all store operations and backup for management of the Store. Duties include product sales, customer service, cash handling, receiving, stocking, deposit preparation, displays, inventory ordering, and occasional event staffing. The Store Program Associate reports directly to the Store Program Manager. This position is scheduled for **14** **hours per week, with regular shifts on** **Fridays and Saturdays**. This position is covered under the Ecology Center/ IWW Collective Bargaining Agreement and requires union membership.

**Essential Duties**

* Greet and assist customers: Provide friendly and professional customer service, greet


customers as they enter the Store, and offer assistance with finding products or answering questions.

* Process sales transactions: Operate cash registers and POS systems accurately, process payments, issue receipts, and give appropriate change to customers and work responsibly and independently in the Store Manager's absence.
* Assist in creating Store displays, merchandising, advertisements, and development of marketing strategies
* Work in collaboration with the Store Program Manager and the Communications program team to support social media initiatives,newsletters and other communication channels to support outreach, marketing, and community engagement.
* Receive, price, and stock store inventorysales reports
* Assist in conducting annual inventory for year\-end closing.
* Ensure that all store monies received are handled safely, following established cash\-


handling procedures.

* Assist in the preparation of store deposits within 24 hours of receipt of funds
* Maintain familiarity with, follow, and ensure staff compliance with all Ecology Center policies and procedures in the performance of daily duties
* Maintain product knowledge: Stay informed about the Store's merchandise, including sustainability features, benefits, and pricing, to assist customers with their product inquiries and purchase decisions.
* Ensure that store staff and customers observe safe operating practices and comply with organizational safety policies
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below represent the knowledge, skill, and ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Retail experience, including customer service, sales and cash handling.
* Demonstrated ability to provide quality customer service, including strong communication and interpersonal skills, active listening, and the ability to address customer needs and concerns effectively.
* Knowledge of environmental issues and interest in sustainability.
* Prior experience of working on social media postings, newsletter or writing would be preferred.
* Must be detail\-oriented, accurate, efficient, and well\-organized.
* Proven ability to work independently and exercise good judgment in a variety of environments and situations.
* Proven ability to assist in the management of Store operations.
* Competency with word processing, spreadsheets, data entry and ability and willingness to learn new applications as needed.
* Proven ability and enthusiasm for developing and maintaining relationships with participants including vendors, customers, neighbors, and other members of the public.
* The ability and willingness to monitor and enforce policies with vendors and the public.
* Flexibility and creativity, capacity to adapt quickly and find innovative solutions to unique challenges.
* Strong verbal communication and organizational/time\-management skills.
* Strong team collaboration skills, fostering a cooperative and inclusive work environment.

**Education and Experience**

* High School Diploma/GED
* One year of prior work experience including retail and cash handling experience

**Physical Demands**


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of the job, the employee is required to:

* Regularly talk or hear up to 7 hours a day;
* Regularly sit, type, and use the mouse up to 7 hours a day;
* Regularly sit and stand from chair up to 20 times a day;
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
* Regularly stand, kneel, climb, walk, use hands to finger, handle or feel, and reach with hands and arms;

ORGANIZATIONAL PROFILE
  

Founded through a ballot initiative in 2018, the Civic Engagement Commission promotes civic participation to increase civic trust and strengthen democracy in New York City. The Charter mandates the Commission with running a citywide participatory budgeting program, providing poll site language assistance, providing technical assistance to community boards, partnering with community\-based organizations and civic leaders to increase awareness of City services, and assisting City agencies in developing civic engagement initiatives. The Commission also oversees the Taskforce for Racial Inclusion and Equity Neighborhood Coalition program.
  

  

About the Vote Language Assistance Program: The Voter Language Assistance (VLA) Program (VLA) provides interpretation services for limited\-English\-proficient voters during general and primary elections. Vega is the premier AI\-native claims TPA built to replace that entire stack. Our team is equal parts experienced insurance operators and modern technologists. **Job Summary**  

Under supervision of the PMO Director, the successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating, tracking, and documenting facility, repair, renovation, maintenance, and capital improvement projects, and monitoring project schedules, budgets, milestones, outstanding issues, and required agency actions. Serves as a coordination point between DJJ Engineering, facility leadership, internal agency departments, and external project partners, including the Georgia State Financing and Investment Commission (GSFIC). The position does not independently make project, engineering, contractual, financial, procurement, or construction decisions.

  

  

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**  

* Maintains project schedules, milestone trackers, project files, meeting notes, action\-item logs, and other project documentation.
* Monitors project budgets, expenditures, commitments, funding balances, and other financial information and reports potential concerns.
* Coordinates meetings, site visits, facility access, documentation, and communications.
* Follows up with responsible parties on outstanding project activities.
* Collects project information from facilities, contractors, consultants, GSFIC, and internal DJJ departments for review by project sponsor.
* Assists with preparation of project scopes, cost information, capital requests, Major Repair and Renovation requests, project summaries, and supporting documentation.
* Participates in project meetings and site visits and documents project status, issues, decisions, and required follow\-up.
* Identifies and communicates potential delays, budget concerns, operational conflicts, or unresolved issues.
* Coordinates with DJJ Finance, Budget, Procurement, Information Technology, Security, facility leadership, and other program areas as directed.
* Tracks punch\-list items, warranties, project closeout documentation, and outstanding deficiencies and reports unresolved matters to project sponsor.
* Assists with compiling project information requested by DJJ leadership, OPB, GSFIC, and other state entities.
* Performs other project coordination and administrative duties consistent with the assigned DOAS classification.
**GSFIC Relationship and Role Boundaries**  

For GSFIC\-administered projects, the Associate Project Manager serves as a DJJ project liaison and coordinator, working closely with DJJ Engineering. The employee may attend meetings, gather information, track action items, coordinate DJJ responses, and communicate operational requirements.
  

The employee does not direct GSFIC project managers, architects, engineers, consultants, or contractors and does not exercise contractual authority or independently approve project scope, schedules, designs, payments, change orders, or construction decisions. Decision\-Making Authority The position has no independent approval or contracting authority. The Associate Project Manager
  

gathers information, coordinates activities, monitors project status, identifies issues, and provides recommendations or information for management review. Decisions involving project scope, funding, contracts, procurement, design, construction, schedules, or significant operational matters are referred to the appropriate authorized DJJ official.  

  



**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* High school diploma or GED AND one year of professional level experience related to the area of assignment.

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Two years of experience supporting or coordinating engineering, construction, facilities, maintenance, renovation, or capital projects.
* Experience tracking multiple projects, schedules, budgets, and action items.
* Ability to read and understand basic project schedules, construction documents, cost estimates, and project reports.
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including active listening and the ability to clearly convey information to others.
* Ability to analyze, identify, and resolve issues or problems that may arise in a project.
* Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and priorities.
* Attention to detail and desire for accuracy.
* Experience working in state government or another public\-sector environment preferred.
* Experience working with architects, engineers, contractors, or construction/project management organizations preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and Asana or Microsoft Project.
* Ability to travel to DJJ facilities throughout Georgia as required.

**Benefits:**

In addition to a competitive salary \& benefits, GA Department of Juvenile Justice is part of a statewide initiative called Total Rewards that seeks to attract and retain employees by supplementing their base pay and benefits with programs designed to improve the quality of their work environment and lead to greater job satisfaction and work/life balance. The Account Manager works with sales and the support teams to implement new or renewing accounts, ensuring that a high service level is met. The Account Manager will also work with high\-level, key employees to maintain the ongoing client relationships. The Account Manager must also be personable, maintain a high\-level of professionalism and be able to travel for client meetings.

Communication Demands: • Interpersonal Skills: Strong ability to build relationships and communicate effectively with employees, managers, clients and external vendors. • Cultural Sensitivity: Communicate with individuals from diverse cultural backgrounds, demonstrating cultural awareness and sensitivity. • Written Communication: Prepare clear and concise documentation, including emails and notes. • Verbal Communication: Lead planning sessions and team meetings. Provide clear instructions and support for clients, employees and managers. • Presentation Skills: Present information effectively in training sessions with employees and other departments.

\*\*\***This role is a PPC role\*\*\***
Purchasing Power is a leading employee purchase program that helps people buy the products and services they need through the convenience of payroll deduction. As part of PROG Holdings (NYSE: PRG), a FinTech holding company with more than 20 years of experience, we’re focused on building simple, responsible financial solutions that put people first. We are hiring a **Strategic Account Manager** that will serve as the trusted advisor and primary liaison to clients and brokers with the objectives of initiating and cultivating successful partnerships between Purchasing Power and key client accounts and brokers. The SAE will be responsible for the overall management of internal activities of a growing book of accounts within designated broker and client territories. *This is a hybrid role that requires in‑office presence in Atlanta, Georgia.*

**What You Will Do:**

* Meet target revenue and revenue per eligible rates for each assigned account
* Represent Purchasing Power at the executive level of our clients and brokers to build strong relationships and be able to educate each audience (broker, client, and consumer) of our value proposition
* Proactively offer guidance to help educate our broker and client partners for needed training programs
* Expand and cultivate each account and assigned broker region through frequent visits, ongoing communication, and accurate reporting
* Develop marketing opportunities for promotion to maximize program effectiveness for each account, utilizing broker portals and other communication tools available
* Ensure that account contract terms are adhered to and that all account needs are addressed
* Provide insight and information to cross\-functional internal departments to assist SAE to become a valuable resource and partner
* Understand of account industry trends as well as voluntary benefit trends to identity new business opportunities with client and broker partners
* Proactively identify and report potential risks associated with each client and broker
* Effectively identify and partner with brokers to execute any upsell opportunities
* Optimize client and broker experience across sales, client services, marketing, and customer experience
* Serve as account owner and decision maker on relationship affecting issues/escalations
* Develop strategic recommendation for continual improvement and expansion of client and broker relationships
* Document new processes/policies/procedures relating to the client and oversees training on these to applicable internal staff

**The Experience You Will Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business or related field or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5\+ years of Account management experience
* Experience with managing employee benefit offerings / programs
* Possess financial acumen, analytical and operations skills
* Experience using Microsoft Office products (Pivot tables, Power Point, etc)
* Experience using CRM tools (Salesforce)
* Able to travel as needed for client stewardships, benefit fairs, client/broker, and events
* Proven annual goal attainment
* Superior written and oral communication skills and excellent presentation skills
* Strong time management and organizational skills; ability to maintain a high quality of work in a deadline driven environment
* AI\-enabled tools are already part of how work gets done across our organization, and their use will continue to expand over time. We value people who are curious, adaptable, and open to learning as roles and workflows evolve.
* Ability to build relationships \& network both internally and externally
* Ability to work in\-office 3 days a week
* Ability to travel 35% of the time
*Purchasing Power welcomes and encourages diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate in any aspect of employment on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, age, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Purchasing Power does business.*

jobs.description:

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food \& beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology.  

  

Barry\-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper\-converting industries. By blending people\-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose\-driven growth, Barry\-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.  

  

**Job Description:**

Cadence Technologies, a subsidiary of Barry\-Wehmiller Design Group, is a national distributor for industry leading process component manufacturers such as SPX, Waukesha, APV, Alfa Laval, Endress\+Hauser, Rosemount and Anderson Instruments. Our process equipment and instrumentation support the leading food and beverage manufacturing companies. Cadence specializes in having a highly experienced team that provides our customers with outstanding customer service and quick delivery times.
We are focused on providing our professionals with opportunities for leadership and career advancement within a thriving work environment and a unique people\-centric culture. We offer a robust, centralized learning and development program to improve the career experience for every professional. For more information, please visit www.cadencetechnologies.com .

Cadence supports many of the largest food/beverage manufacturing companies with facilities located southeast region of the United States by providing them with parts and equipment made by the leading sanitary process equipment manufacturers.


The outside sales position is responsible for developing client relationships of various levels within an assigned account or with accounts in the assigned territory. This professional should also work in conjunction with the insides sales, engineering and service team along with various manufacturer representatives to collaborate on solutions.


**\*\*\*\* MUST LIVE IN STATE OF GEORGIA \*\*\*\***

Account Management


* Increase margins with established high\-volume customers by leveraging created value

* Identify new accounts through traditional business development methods (lead sharing, cold calling, contact relationships, etc.)

Contact Management


* Develop strong relationships with client decision\-makers in procurement, maintenance, engineering and sanitation
* Maintain relationships with key professionals across different manufacturing facilities
* Analyze pain points, barriers, limitations and capabilities of client decision makers to pinpoint value creation opportunities
* Analyze and engage with decision\-making teams at each facility
* Develop relationships with each of our manufacturer representatives through collaborative selling and joint client calls for training and product solution development
* Collaborate with inside sales team through lead sharing and strategic support
* Foster collaboration between other outsides sales team members

Product Sales Development


* Implement aggressive pricing strategies to capture new product lines and displace competition
* Innovate value\-added solutions beyond standard equipment/parts supply
* Identify innovative strategies to harvest value by selling above list price
* Promote and sell Cadence services (pump, valves, homogenizers, Votators, etc.)
* Contribute insight into opportunities to expand services offerings, focusing on low risk, easily supported options

Technical Development


* Provide industry insights on equipment and components to end users
* Conduct training sessions for maintenance personnel on supported products
* Offer technical support for products from supported manufacturers
* Identify engineering lead opportunities for Design Group leadership

Sales Campaigns


* Promote and market new products or services associated with planned sales campaigns
* Collect feedback and gauge interest from clients

* Proven experience in industrial equipment sales or related field
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and equipment

* Strategic thinking and ability to identify growth opportunities

jobs.description:
**About Atlanta United FC**


Atlanta United is Major League Soccer’s 22nd franchise and began play in 2017\. The club’s avid fan base has set MLS records in fan participation, including leading the MLS in number of season tickets sold for an expansion franchise and setting a new record for number of attendees at an MLS match. Atlanta United is owned by Arthur Blank, co\-founder of the Home Depot, and led by club President Darren Eales. Atlanta United is a member of AMB Sports \& Entertainment, which also includes the Atlanta Falcons and Mercedes\-Benz Stadium.

**About Atlanta United FC Academy**


Officially launched in 2016 prior to its first season in MLS, the Atlanta United Academy program aims to be the leading platform of youth soccer development in the Southeast and currently competes in the U.S. Soccer Development Academy program. The ATL UTD Academy consists of teams in age groups U\-12, U\-13, U\-14, U\-15, U\-16, U\-17 and U\-19\. Shared with the first team, the Academy trains and competes out of the Training Ground.

**About AMB Sports \+ Entertainment Group**


AMB Sports \& Entertainment Group is a subsidiary of AMB Group, LLC, and is comprised of the Atlanta Falcons Football Club, LLC, Atlanta’s Major League Soccer team, Atlanta United FC, and the new Mercedes\-Benz Stadium.


Position Summary


This position provides support and assistance in the areas of ticket resolution, order fulfillment and ticket distribution for Atlanta United and Atlanta United 2\.


Roles and Responsibilities

* Assist in the processing and establishment of season ticket, group and single match ticket accounts.
* Provide game\-day support in the area of ticket resolution, customer service, and other ticketing needs.
* Provide daily support to internal sales and customer service teams.
* Coordinate in\-house and on\-line ticket order fulfillment.
* Aid in other duties, functions, and tasks as assigned by full\-time associates of the department.
* Assist with Atlanta United 2 matches.


Qualifications and Education Requirements

* Ability to deliver excellent service to fans.
* Strong written and oral communication, prioritization, and organization skills.
* Proficient with MS Word and Excel.
* Ticketmaster Archtics experience a plus but not required.
* Ability to multi\-task, problem solve effectively and handle stressful and difficult situations.
* Must be able to work Monday through Friday and match days (during week or on weekends).

**Required Skills**

* Excellent oral communication skills.
* Excellent time management and organizational skills.
* Excellent problem solving/critical thinking skills.
* Ability to operate a variety of computer applications including but not limited to Microsoft’s suite of products such as Word, Excel and Outlook, Ticketmaster and customized in\-house ticketing system and database.
* Ability to work well in a team environment and autonomously.


The requirements for this position include, but are not limited to, those outlined above. All duties and requirements are essential job functions and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise. It is the employer’s discretion to add or change the duties or requirements of this position at any time.

Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data\-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.



Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare's greatest needs. Through our mission\-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.

**Work Location:** This position is designated as remote. However, employees who reside within a 40\-mile radius of one of our office locations in Tampa, FL; Canonsburg, PA; or Bowie, MD will follow a hybrid work schedule and are expected to work in the office two days per week (Tuesdays and Wednesdays).

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, has exceptional communication and organizational skills, and is equally comfortable handling high\-level executive priorities and day\-to\-day administrative responsibilities.



The successful candidate will have a strong sense of ownership and the ability to anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and proactively bring solutions. This individual must be comfortable operating with a high degree of independence and discretion while supporting two senior Finance leaders and navigating a dynamic, constantly changing environment.


**Executive Support \& Operational Leadership**


* Serve as the primary executive support partner to the CFO, anticipating needs, managing priorities, and ensuring seamless day\-to\-day operations.

* Coordinate effectively with other Executive Assistants and key stakeholders across the organization to ensure alignment and smooth execution.
* Maintain visibility into important commitments, deadlines, and follow\-up items to help keep both executives on track.

* Gather, organize, and synthesize information from multiple stakeholders to support executive priorities and decision\-making.
* Ensure executive communications and materials are clear, polished, timely, and appropriately tailored to the audience.


**Calendar, Travel \& Logistics Management**

* Coordinate travel itineraries, accommodations, transportation, and detailed briefings to ensure smooth logistics.
* Plan and execute internal and external meetings, events, and executive engagements.
* Coordinate meeting logistics, including agendas, materials, participants, conference rooms, technology, and follow\-up.
* Ensure the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance are fully prepared for meetings by anticipating needs and coordinating necessary information and materials in advance.
* Adjust quickly to changing schedules and priorities while maintaining organization and professionalism.


**Administrative Excellence**

Chicago Infinity Athletics is a growing youth sports organization offering programs including competitive cheerleading, basketball, tumbling/gymnastics, running and walking programs, and community events.

We are seeking a dependable, organized, energetic **Executive Assistant \& Coordinator** to work directly alongside the Executive Director and help manage the day\-to\-day needs of our organization.

This is not a traditional desk\-only executive assistant position. The ideal candidate is a **hands\-on problem solver** who is comfortable managing administrative work, coordinating youth sports programs, creating social media content, running errands, attending practices and events, and stepping in wherever needed to keep the organization running smoothly.

Responsibilities

**Executive \& Administrative Support**

* Serve as the Executive Director's right\-hand support person
* Help organize schedules, deadlines, payments, registrations, events, and program needs
* Assist with emails, parent communications, text messages, and Band app announcements
* Help maintain organized records for athletes, payments, uniforms, competitions, and program information
* Assist with forms, registrations, paperwork, and other administrative tasks
* Help make sure important deadlines and responsibilities are not missed
* Assist with meetings, school partnerships, community partnerships, and organization follow\-up

**Cheer, Basketball \& Program Operations**

* Assist with registration for competitions, tournaments, performances, and special events
* Track athlete registrations, payments, uniforms, inventory, and other program needs
* Help coordinate uniforms and equipment
* Pick up or drop off supplies when needed
* Purchase items such as water, athletic tape, supplies, or last\-minute program needs
* Arrive early to practices or events when necessary to assist with setup

Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. At RPM, we’re in the business of extraordinary. We believe people\-first is the way to success which is why we provide top industry pay, comprehensive benefits, and a path of upward mobility via career training and education. Join us and start your extraordinary journey today.  


Position Summary:

The Community Manager will oversee all business operations at one of our apartment communities. The successful candidate will possess strong resident relations and interpersonal skills and will have the ability to communicate effectively, take charge, lead, train, be dependable, professional, and a team player.
Responsibilities:
* Leads property staff, conducting candidate interviews, overseeing onboarding, training, timesheet approval, and conducting quarterly discussions and annual assessments in accordance with Company policies, values, standards
* Drive team to achieve performance indicators, offering feedback to underperforming associates, and manage disciplinary actions in collaboration with HR
* Conduct ongoing training with office staff, covering leasing paperwork, workplace safety, and other daily operational needs
* Motivate associates through recognition programs, training, and team\-building activities to boost morale and enhance productivity
* Assist in budget preparation and ensure adherence to approved budgets
* Complete month\-end and year\-end financial reporting and provide monthly budget variance reporting within \+/\- 10% per line item
* Promote resident satisfaction and retention by promptly responding to complaints, questions, and requests and taking appropriate actions to resolve service issues
* Collaborate with the property maintenance team to ensure prompt responses and completion of resident service requests in line with the company's standards
* Provide excellent customer service while maintaining the highest standards for resident service
* Analyze and interpret market and economic trends and partner with marketing to implement short\- and long\-range leasing strategies to achieve occupancy and revenue goals
* Follow eviction procedures, including notice requirements, court representation, and facilitating proceedings as needed
* Manage the client/owner relationship by meeting with the owners, conducting property tours, providing updates, and responding to owner requests as needed to maintain a positive working relationship


Education and Experience:
* Bachelor's degree from a four\-year college or university, or 1\-2 years of relevant experience; or a combination of education and experience
* 3 \+ years of related multi\-family property management experience
* Strong leadership and management skills
* Team player, professional, and effective communication skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and property management software


Qualifications:
**Physical Requirements:*** May be required to sit for extended periods of time while working at a desk
* May be required to climb stairs
* Must be able to read documents, computer screens and data
* Must be able to hear and understand verbal communications in person and over the phone or computer
* May occasionally be required to lift or carry items such as files or office supplies weighing up to 20 pounds
* Must be able to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse and other office equipment

**Work Environment:*** This role is based on site, primarily in an office setting but may require at times that the employee spends some time outside with exposure to the elements
* The office is an open setting which may include bright lights, constant noises and distractions
* A flexible schedule is required and hours include weekdays, nights, and weekends (including Saturdays and Sundays) as needed to meet business needs
