jobs.title: Dental Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**I\-Med Claims**  

I\-Med claims is a healthcare revenue cycle management and medical billing company specializing in comprehensive billing and practice management solutions for healthcare providers across the United States. The organization provides end\-to\-end RCM services including medical billing, coding support, credentialing, denial management, eligibility verification, accounts receivable management, and practice management solutions for a wide range of medical specialties. With a technology\-driven and client\-focused approach, I\-Med Claims helps healthcare practices optimize reimbursements, improve operational efficiency, reduce claim denials, and streamline financial performance so providers can focus on delivering quality patient care.

**Overview**


We are looking for a driven and results\-oriented Dental Business Development Representative who thrives on prospecting, cold calling, and building strong client relationships. In this role, you will be the first point of contact for new leads, responsible for qualifying prospects, nurturing opportunities through consistent follow\-up, booking appointments, supporting the sales process through to close, and fueling our sales pipeline. This opportunity offers uncapped commission in addition to base salary.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct warm\-calling efforts to engage potential customers and nurture leads.
* Analyze market trends and customer needs to identify new business opportunities.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and sales activities using relevant software.
* Foster strong relationships with customers by delivering exceptional customer service.
* Conduct daily in\-person prospecting at dental offices.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with prospective and existing clients.
* Deliver sales presentations and communicate product/service value effectively.
* Negotiate contracts and close new business opportunities.
* Track and manage all activities, appointments, and pipeline in CRM systems.
* Work with operations team while on boarding new client.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 2 years of B2B sales experience
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills
* High level of adaptability and resilience in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong organizational and time\-management abilities
* Positive, energetic, Professional and approachable demeanor
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation required
* Experience in medical, dental, or insurance sales highly preferred (but not needed)

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Department**


SSD: Center for the Economics of Human Development \- Staff and Temporary Employees **About the Department**


The Center for the Economics of Human Development (CEHD) brings together top\-tier researchers to conduct and disseminate rigorous interdisciplinary research that identifies and explores the conditions under which people develop the skills necessary to thrive in society and achieve their fullest potential. CEHD’s research is guided by Nobel laureate James J. Heckman and includes a comprehensive array of interrelated projects and initiatives which promote a thorough empirical understanding of human flourishing. Unifying this research is an evolving idea that capacities and skills acquired over the lifecycle, starting at conception, transform many aspects of the life course at all stages, ranging from employment and earning prospects to overall health. **Job Summary**


The job provides confidential and high\-level office and location support activities by acting as a lead and coordinating the work of others. Identifies, enhances, and applies specific processes and procedures to maximize the efficiencies of the University to which the support is being provided. May ensure the correct functioning of facilities, office and/or business support services.  

  

Reporting to the Executive Director, the Executive Assistant provides comprehensive executive\-level administrative and operational support for the Center's leadership, spanning communications, scheduling, events, travel, and special projects. The role serves as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, upholding confidentiality and exercising discretion in handling sensitive matters. This position is in person.  

The role emphasizes coordination, judgment, organization, and process improvement. The position works within a collaborative administrative model alongside other members of the Center's operations team to ensure seamless support for leadership, faculty, visitors, and strategic initiatives, under the direction of the Executive Director.**Responsibilities**

* Serves as the primary point of contact for the Faculty Director's office, managing written and verbal communications with professionalism and confidentiality. Triages emails from one or more email inboxes, telephone calls, and media and speaking requests, including domestic and international inquiries submitted via email or web form. Resolves routine and complex inquiries. Stays informed of relevant University programs and initiatives, apprising the Executive Director of matters requiring attention.
* Provides oversight of the Faculty Director's calendar and scheduling, including triaging and confirming internal and external engagements, developing agendas, communicating meeting expectations, and following up with participants on resulting deliverables. Tracks internal, external, and publication\-related deadlines. Assists in managing daily office operations which support the Faculty Director, exercising considerable discretion and judgment as to priorities and effective use of the Director's time, under the direction of the Executive Director.
* Manages travel arrangements and fiscal administration for the Faculty Director, including domestic and international itineraries, visa coordination, and reimbursement processing for travel, honoraria, and other receivables in accordance with University and sponsor policies. Assist with travel requests and prepare travel itineraries and briefing materials for leaders as needed. Manages general office administration functions, including supply ordering, vendor coordination, document filing systems, expense reports, reimbursements, and invoices. Handles sensitive financial information with discretion.
* Guides high\-priority and ad hoc projects from the Faculty Director and Executive Director through completion, including immediate action items and recurring projects such as graduate student recommendation letters and annual teaching support. Serves as a point of contact for ad hoc projects; tracks deliverables, timelines, and action items; flags issues; and keeps stakeholders aligned and informed of progress. In coordination with the Executive Director, supports stewardship of CEHD's network of affiliates, alumni, and prospective funders, identifying opportunities to advance relationships and promote the Center's work.
* Plans and executes workshops, speaker series, and other events at the direction of the Executive Director. Manages the full logistical lifecycle, including securing speakers, arranging travel and accommodations, booking space and catering, coordinating on\-site delivery, preparing and reconciling budgets, and completing post\-event reporting. Hosts academic visitors, including faculty and graduate students, for short\-term collaborative stays by coordinating University appointments, visit logistics, and engagement with the local research community. Serves as a welcoming and professional first point of contact for office visitors, guests, and incoming inquiries, routing requests to appropriate staff in a timely manner.
* Initiates correspondence and other written materials under own signature or for signature of the leader. Triages emails and telephone calls for action. Resolves routine and complex inquiries. May act as liaison to Board of Directors.
* Prepare special reports and summaries, assists in managing daily operation of the office, and may assist in developing administrative goals and policies. Maintains the leader's calendar, exercising considerable discretion and judgment as to priorities and effective use of the leader's time.
* Performs other related work as needed.

jobs.description:
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data\-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.



Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare's greatest needs. Through our mission\-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.

**Work Location:** This position is designated as remote. However, employees who reside within a 40\-mile radius of one of our office locations in Tampa, FL; Canonsburg, PA; or Bowie, MD will follow a hybrid work schedule and are expected to work in the office two days per week (Tuesdays and Wednesdays).


**Position Summary**



We are seeking a highly skilled, proactive, and operationally minded Executive Assistant to support the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and provide executive support to the SVP, Head of Finance. This role will also serve as a key connector across the Finance organization and broader executive leadership team.



This role is designed for a strategic, detail\-oriented professional who will be responsible for creating order, driving operational excellence, and ensuring priorities remain aligned, timelines are met, and leaders stay on course. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, has exceptional communication and organizational skills, and is equally comfortable handling high\-level executive priorities and day\-to\-day administrative responsibilities.



The successful candidate will have a strong sense of ownership and the ability to anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and proactively bring solutions. This individual must be comfortable operating with a high degree of independence and discretion while supporting two senior Finance leaders and navigating a dynamic, constantly changing environment.


**Executive Support \& Operational Leadership**


* Serve as the primary executive support partner to the CFO, anticipating needs, managing priorities, and ensuring seamless day\-to\-day operations.
* Provide executive support to the SVP, Head of Finance, including calendar management, meeting coordination, travel, communications, and other administrative needs.
* Drive follow\-through on decisions, action items, and projects to ensure clarity, accountability, and timely execution.
* Act as an extension of the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance in meetings and communications, coordinating effectively across Finance and other functions.
* Help coordinate priorities, deadlines, commitments, and follow\-up across the CFO's and SVP's organizations.
* Proactively identify potential issues, scheduling conflicts, or gaps and bring forward solutions.
* Coordinate effectively with other Executive Assistants and key stakeholders across the organization to ensure alignment and smooth execution.
* Maintain visibility into important commitments, deadlines, and follow\-up items to help keep both executives on track.


**Presentation Development \& Communication**


* Create high\-quality presentations, reports, executive team materials, and board\-level materials that clearly communicate complex financial and business information.
* Prepare and format materials using **PowerPoint and Excel**, ensuring a high degree of accuracy, professionalism, and attention to detail.
* Support the preparation and coordination of materials for executive leadership meetings, board meetings, Finance meetings, and other key business reviews.
* Draft executive communications, talking points, meeting agendas, and internal updates as needed.
* Gather, organize, and synthesize information from multiple stakeholders to support executive priorities and decision\-making.
* Ensure executive communications and materials are clear, polished, timely, and appropriately tailored to the audience.


**Calendar, Travel \& Logistics Management**


* Manage complex, dynamic calendars and prioritize competing scheduling needs for the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance.
* Exercise sound judgment when determining priorities, resolving scheduling conflicts, and protecting executive time.
* Coordinate travel itineraries, accommodations, transportation, and detailed briefings to ensure smooth logistics.
* Plan and execute internal and external meetings, events, and executive engagements.
* Coordinate meeting logistics, including agendas, materials, participants, conference rooms, technology, and follow\-up.
* Ensure the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance are fully prepared for meetings by anticipating needs and coordinating necessary information and materials in advance.
* Adjust quickly to changing schedules and priorities while maintaining organization and professionalism.


**Administrative Excellence**


* Oversee traditional executive administrative activities, including expense reports, document management, contract routing, and other administrative processes.
* Serve as a point of contact for internal and external partners on behalf of the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance.
* Coordinate with Finance leaders, executive assistants, and other key stakeholders to facilitate efficient communication and execution.
* Maintain organized records, files, and workflows, ensuring important information and commitments are easily accessible.
* Monitor and follow up on outstanding items to ensure timely completion.
* Continuously refine and improve administrative and operational processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.

new_jobs.title: COB Graduate Program Specialist - 2 Positions Available
new_jobs.description:
**Job no:** 561957  

**Work type:** Staff  

**Location:** Long Beach  

**Categories:** Unit 4 \- APC \- Academic Professionals of California, Administrative, Full Time  

Join the vibrant community at California State University, Long Beach (CSULB)!



Located just three miles from the Pacific Ocean, CSULB offers an inspiring workplace and an exceptional Southern California lifestyle. Our 322\-acre campus—one of the largest in the CSU system—serves more than 42,000 students and is known for its commitment to student success, innovation, and impactful academic and research initiatives.



As a member of the CSULB community, you’ll experience a dynamic environment filled with cultural landmarks, collaborative energy, and opportunities to make a meaningful difference.



Work\-life balance thrives here. Long Beach blends coastal relaxation with urban vibrancy, offering miles of beaches, year\-round sunshine, a thriving arts and food scene, and convenient access to both Los Angeles and Orange County. It’s an ideal place to grow your career while enjoying everything Southern California has to offer.



Join the California State University (CSU) and explore career opportunities that advance student success and strengthen California’s future—offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and professional growth.



### **Job Summary**



This position is responsible for all academic support services and community engagement for designated state support and self\-support Master of Business Administration (MBA) programs and Master of Science (MS) graduate programs including, but not limited to, on\-line admission processes, academic counseling, probation counseling, and monitoring of academic progress to meet degree requirements. They work directly with applicants, matriculated graduate students, program alumni, Program Advisory Boards, College of Business Administration (CBA) faculty and other administrators, the Center for International Education, the Career Development Center, Enrollment Services, and the College of Professional \& Continuing Education (CPaCE).



### **Key Responsibilities**


* Graduate Admissions
* Advising graduate students
* Cohort administration
* Office administration \& Other duties as assigned

### **Department**



COB Graduate Programs Office



### **Time Base**



1\.0 time\-base, 40 hours per week.



### **Duration of Appointment**



This is a temporary position for 1 year with no permanent status granted. Temporary assignments may expire prior to the ending date.



### **Classification**



Student Services Professional III



### **Compensation**



Salary placement is determined by the education, experience, and qualifications the candidate brings to the position, internal equity, and the hiring department’s fiscal resources.


* Hiring Range: The hiring range for this position is $5,540 \- $6,182 per month commensurate with candidate's education, experience, skills, and training.
* CSU Classification Salary Range: The CSU Classification Salary Range for this position is $5,540 \- $7,893 per month.

### **Benefits**



At California State University (CSU), we prioritize the health, growth, and success of our employees. Our benefits program reflects our commitment to your overall well\-being.



To be eligible for full benefits, employees must be appointed at least half\-time (.50 FTE) with an appointment lasting more than six months and one day. Benefits eligibility and offerings may vary based on appointment type, classification, and applicable collective bargaining agreement. Eligible employees may have access to a comprehensive benefits package that can include:


* **Paid Time Off:** Up to 24 vacation days per year (based on employee group and/or length of service), 14 paid holidays, and 12 sick days annually with unlimited accrual.
* **Health Coverage:** A variety of medical, dental, and vision plans.
* **Retirement Plans:** Participation in the CalPERS defined benefit plan, along with voluntary savings options such as 403(b), 401(k), and 457 plans.
* **Educational Benefits:** Tuition fee waiver programs for eligible employees; dependent eligibility varies by employee group and bargaining unit.
* **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** Confidential counseling and support services for employees and their families.
* **Additional Benefits:** Wellness programs, professional development opportunities, and insurance options including life, disability, and pet insurance.


Candidates are encouraged to review the appropriate CSU Employee Benefits Summary for details specific to their position. Additionally, the CSU Total Compensation Calculator is available to help prospective employees understand the full value of the CSU benefits package and how it complements base salary.



### **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**



This position is a student\-focused higher education professional with experience in graduate recruitment, admissions, advising, and program administration. They excel at engaging prospective students through outreach events, presentations, virtual information sessions, and personalized follow\-up, while effectively managing admissions processes through systems such as Salesforce, WebAdmit, and Cal State Apply. They provide comprehensive academic advising, helping students navigate degree requirements, university policies, enrollment, and academic progress, while connecting them to campus resources that support their success.

**Account Manager – Industrial Electrical Services**

**Company:** GRC Industrial, LLC

**Location:** Anaheim, CA — Hybrid, with travel to customer locations for job walks

**Job Type:** Full\-time

**Compensation:** Competitive base salary with uncapped performance incentives based on sales and project profitability

**Benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, PTO, vehicle allowance or company vehicle, phone/laptop

**About GRC Industrial**

GRC Industrial, LLC is an industrial electrical contractor serving manufacturing clients across California, Arizona, and Nevada. We deliver electrical construction, facility upgrade, and equipment installation projects for some of the most demanding industrial environments in the region — from process plants to high\-tech manufacturing facilities.

**Our Core Values**

At GRC Industrial, we believe great results come from great teams. We work hard, support each other, take pride in what we do, and want to build a company where people enjoy working together.

We value a team\-first mentality, open communication, collaboration, professionalism, accountability, and respect. We expect our leaders to take ownership, approach challenges constructively, work together toward solutions, value the expertise of both our office and field teams, and bring a positive attitude to work each day.

Success at GRC isn’t just about individual performance — it’s about delivering great results while helping the people around you succeed and building a company we’re all proud to be part of.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an Account Manager to grow and manage relationships with industrial manufacturing clients — specifically in the food \& beverage, automotive, and aerospace sectors. You’ll be the face of GRC Industrial to plant managers, facility engineers, project managers, and procurement teams, identifying electrical construction and maintenance opportunities and turning them into won work.

This is a hunter\-and\-farmer role: you’ll develop new accounts in our target verticals while deepening relationships with existing clients to capture repeat and negotiated work.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify, pursue, and win industrial electrical projects (installations, upgrades, expansions, equipment hookups, controls, and maintenance contracts) with food \& beverage, automotive, and aerospace manufacturers
* Build and maintain relationships with plant engineering, facilities, maintenance, and capital projects teams at target accounts
* Develop a territory plan and pipeline; track opportunities from lead through award
* Partner with our estimating team on scope reviews, walk\-downs, RFIs, and proposal strategy to ensure bids match what the client actually needs
* Attend pre\-bid meetings and site walks; gather field intelligence that sharpens our pricing and win rate
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and contract scope in coordination with leadership
* Stay in front of clients through the life of a project — handling change order conversations, resolving issues, and setting up the next opportunity
* Represent GRC Industrial at industry events, trade associations, and networking functions
* Maintain accurate CRM records, forecasts, and activity reporting

**What You Bring**

**Required:**

* 3\+ years of B2B sales or account management experience in electrical contracting, industrial construction, MEP services, or a closely related trade
* Working knowledge of industrial electrical systems and construction project delivery (bid/spec, design\-build, negotiated work)
* Proven track record of winning and growing accounts with industrial or manufacturing clients
* Ability to read plans and specs well enough to have credible technical conversations with facility engineers
* Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel regularly to customer sites for job walks and client meetings

**Preferred:**

* Existing relationships in food \& beverage, automotive, or aerospace manufacturing
* Field experience as an electrician, electrical PM, or estimator
* Familiarity with safety prequalification systems (ISNetworld, Avetta) and GMP/cleanroom environments
* Experience with CRM software and construction takeoff/estimating workflows

**Why GRC Industrial**

* Established contractor with a strong reputation and repeat industrial client base
* Direct access to leadership — your input shapes which work we chase
* Uncapped earning potential tied to the business you bring in

We are seeking an experienced **Assistant Project Manager (APM)** to support the successful delivery of commercial construction projects from preconstruction through completion. The APM will work closely with Project Managers, Superintendents, subcontractors, clients, architects, designers, and building owners to manage project schedules, budgets, documentation, materials, costs, and day\-to\-day project coordination.

This is an excellent opportunity for a construction professional who wants to take the next step in their career with a well\-established commercial construction organization.

* Support Project Managers with the day\-to\-day management of commercial construction projects.
* Assist with **RFP responses, estimating, budgets, bids, and project proposals**.
* Create, maintain, and update project schedules in coordination with Project Managers and Superintendents.
* Track project scope, subcontractor pricing, change orders, and revised work.
* Monitor project budgets, costs, commitments, and financial reporting.
